info.name: StudyPath SA Public Catalogue API (Contract Tests)
info.description: Contract-scoped requests only. Runtime is not verified; configure API_BASE_URL and run only against an explicitly approved test runtime. No learner inputs or secrets are sent.

request.description: Contract: GET /api/v1/programmes. Expect 200 JSON only when an approved runtime and published catalogue exist.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Catalogue envelope is present', () => { pm.expect(body).to.have.property('contractVersion'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('catalogueVersion'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); }); }

request.description: Contract requires 406 NOT_ACCEPTABLE when application/json is not acceptable. Run only against an approved runtime.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 406) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Error code is NOT_ACCEPTABLE', () => pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('NOT_ACCEPTABLE')); }
